Working cross-functionally with Planning, Production, Finance, Culinary, and Operations, you ll play a key role in ensuring the right products are available at the right time, while driving operational excellence and supporting Factor s continued growth. Own the end-to-end procurement operations process, ensuring ingredients and packaging are delivered On Time, In Full, and In Quality (OTIFQ) to support uninterrupted production. Drive inventory governance, ensuing product availability and operational efficiency while minimising waste and stock risk. Champion our zero-waste strategy through continuous optimisation of purchasing parameters, inventory controls, and forecasting inputs. Partner closely with Planning, Finance, Supply Chain, Culinary, and Production to optimize purchasing strategies and ensure smooth day-to-day operations. Monitor procurement KPIs, purchasing data, and system accuracy, using insights to identify trends, resolve discrepancies, and drive operational improvements. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and standardise procurement and inventory processes through data, technology, and continuous improvement initiatives. jobs.title: Senior Fleet Manager
jobs.description: About HIVED 📦 At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing. Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market. Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures , Maersk Growth , Pale Blue Dot VC , Eka Ventures , NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery. Role Overview 📝 As Senior Fleet Manager, you will be responsible for the on the road performance of our delivery fleet. You will lead the fleet team in ensuring that our fleet is safe, compliant and cost efficient. You will own vehicle on-boarding and allocation, repairs & maintenance and admin functions. You’ll play a crucial role in supporting our ops run teams to enable our fast growth and increasing fleet size. Du unterstützt unseren Key Account Director bei der wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen Umsetzung der Projekte und hast Freude daran, bestehende und neue Kundengeschäfte kreativ weiterzuentwickeln. Tu veux avoir un impact direct sur la chaîne logistique mondiale d une entreprise qui rend le sport accessible à tous ? Tu automatiseras les processus d administration et de déploiement en utilisant l Infrastructure as Code. Déployer et piloter des solutions réseau et infrastructure efficientes à l échelle mondiale. Sécuriser nos actifs et ceux de nos partenaires au sein des flux logistiques. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com Overview The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for managing assigned accounts end-to-end, including project planning, execution, monitoring, delivery, and closure in line with Welocalize’s standard processes and tools. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will partner with the Operations Squad Lead to support large enterprise accounts. This role will serve as the primary project-level contact for clients, building strong customer relationships while collaborating closely with Welocalize account directors and production teams to maximize delivery performance, client satisfaction, quality, and profitability. The ideal candidate is a motivated and dependable professional with strong relationship-building skills across cross-functional teams. They should bring the adaptability, resilience, and energy needed to succeed in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Main Duties Lead and supervise global teams, including internal and external stakeholders, with responsibility for both direct and indirect reports. Prepare, analyze, and implement project plan

jobs.description: We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Product Owner (Contractor) for two AI Pods that build the foundations of Numa, Enumerate ’s AI product line, including Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist.
